message: Hey, I am purchasing your furniture listing for ₹8,500. I have initiated payment through PhonePe. Kindly scan this QR code and punch in your 4-digit UPI PIN to receive the money directly into your bank.
explanation: Golden Rule of UPI: You NEVER need to scan a QR code or enter your UPI PIN to RECEIVE money. Entering your PIN ALWAYS transfers money OUT of your account.
redFlags: Claims entering UPI PIN is required to receive funds
Sends QR code claiming it will credit your account
Buyer rushing the transaction without inspecting item

choices.text: Scan QR code and enter UPI PIN so payment clears
choices.feedback: Critical Mistake! Entering your PIN will instantly deduct ₹8,500 from your account and send it to the thief.

choices.text: Decline and inform buyer that receiving UPI payments NEVER requires a PIN
choices.feedback: Excellent defense! UPI PIN is solely for authenticating outgoing debit transactions.

choices.text: Scan the QR code but enter a fake 4-digit PIN to test them
choices.feedback: Risky! Scanning untrusted QR codes could trigger malicious intents or app exploits.
